points.text: Removing ambiguity leaves context gathering for under-specified real tasks untested.
"Long-horizon" misleading: ~4 files, 100 LoC, standard 50-call budget.
Evaluation uses a single agent harness.
No inference-time scaling or sampling; only pass@1.
Complexity measured by files/lines only; diff-hunk distribution missing.
Unclear whether new tests added after dropping broad tests.
Repository purchase agreement details missing; resale to competitors would raise fairness issues.
No argument why purchasing beats continuously refreshed benchmarks against contamination.
Only one agent scaffold (SWE-agent) evaluated.
Limited language diversity: only 4 languages.
Long-horizon operationalized as patch size; reductive and oversold.
Limited language coverage; Java, C++, Rust missing.
Contribution incremental: refinement of SWE-Bench, not new methodology.
Only a few languages covered.
Small-mid startup repositories fall short of enterprise realism.
Evaluation tied to one scaffold; alternative frameworks not tested.
Analysis descriptive; little causal interpretation of failures.
Human-provided requirements and interface hints undermine autonomy claim.
Contamination resistance rests on legal premise; no probe; held-out set unreported.
Table 3 totals exceed N and text numbers contradict tables.
Low scores confounded by harness failures; one scaffold; Agentless numbers missing.
"Hours to days", long-horizon and difficulty filtering unmeasured or undescribed.
23% vs >70% SWE-Bench Verified comparison confounds harness, spec and task set.
No confidence intervals; top rankings within noise; "highest score to date" overclaimed.
Commercial repo provenance described inconsistently; partner selection unspecified.
Citation errors for SWE-Bench and Verified.
Per-repository instance cap described inconsistently.
Model mislabeled "DeepSeek Qwen-3 32B".
Judge alignment borrowed from other work; own human agreement unreported.
Contamination resistance asserted without probe.
Long-horizon difficulty not measured by human time or steps.
No annotation-quality report supporting resolvability.
Single-run results; top comparisons within noise.
Text-table mismatches; Table 3 totals exceed N; columns don't match judge categories.
Missing repository list, per-language counts, annotator numbers, funnel statistics.
Figure 4 caption categories absent from text; per-repo limit inconsistent.
Model mislabel, citation errors, repeated section, mismatched titles.
Acknowledgements and text break double-blind anonymity.
Licence/consent for commercial data not stated.
Table 3 internally inconsistent; text misreads it.
Single run, no intervals; rankings within noise; "highest to date" overclaimed.
Results confounded by harness failures; no second scaffold.
No evidence tasks valid/resolvable: no annotator stats, agreement, funnel or audit.
Valid alternative solutions may fail requirement-coupled tests.
Difficulty and long-horizon unmeasured; no human time, difficulty filter or size statistics.
No with/without-requirements ablation; difficulty source unattributed.
Contamination untested; held-out results missing; private code exposed to vendor APIs.
Text resolve rates disagree with Table 1.
Per-repo instance counts inconsistent.
Figure 4 caption, model mislabel, table reference order.
No-ambiguity, test-grounded requirements make tasks spec-to-code, not realistic enterprise triage.
Startup repositories not representative of large enterprise systems.
Commercial set IP, consent, secrets, API exposure and partner selection bias unaddressed.
GPL legal-barrier premise overreaching and unsupported.
Tests as oracle penalize valid alternatives; construct narrower than claimed.
No broader impact discussion.
Per-repository metadata should be provided.
Positioning thin; closest prior benchmarks uncited; "first" claim unargued.
Copyleft contamination argument is a legal premise; needs empirical evidence.
Enterprise and long-horizon framing not established by data or citations.
Failure analysis judge unvalidated; GPT-5 judges own failures.
Citation inaccuracies.

P.summary: Ambiguity removal and hints undermine realism/autonomy.
Complexity metric coarse; diff hunks missing.
Purchasing vs continuously refreshed benchmarks unjustified.

Q.summary: Single run, no CIs; rankings within noise.
Commercial repo provenance, IP and consent.
Annotation quality and dataset statistics missing.
Positioning against closest prior benchmarks thin.
